Variables: color printers, black and white printers
Constraints:
(1.0) * color printers + (0.0) * black and white printers <= 20.0
(0.0) * color printers + (1.0) * black and white printers <= 30.0
(1.0) * color printers + (1.0) * black and white printers <= 35.0
Objective Function:
minimize (-200.0) * color printers + (-70.0) * black and white printers
